## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 12 sept 2026 - 30 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Asdflpi_, 12 sept 2026, 1/5: "Please fix this bug… I watched an ad to claim a reward, but there’s no button to leave the ad. I have to quit the app and re-enter, but can’t claim the reward. The ad is way too long and keeps inducing user to download games, which is pretty distracting for an app meant to help users lock in… Look, I’ve been using this for almost a year now, the old version is really sweet and cute, and it really helps me a lot. But the new updates are just so premium and ad focused that the whole page looked filled and messy. All gifts can only be claimed with ad, and btw I can’t get out of ANY of them."
            2. _Person of pure honesty_, 30 sept 2026, 2/5: "Very good but constant updates that are really annoying and bug the whole app. NO MORE UPDATES"
            3. _Kad2011_, 30 sept 2026, 3/5: "I actually LOVE this app. I found it this week and I’d already had so much more focus when using it, but it drains my battery so much. I did a 40min focus session and it drained my battery by 20% and my phone is getting really hot. I thought it may have just been my phone, but my friend who recommended it is getting the same issue so we’re going to stop using sadly 💔"
